segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the seat count and timing so I can get the order form cleaned up. Last note I had was 42 standard seats and 6 admin seats for the operations team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We may add three more in September, but for this initial order it's 48 total. Finance asked that we not pre-buy those until the new hires are actually onboard.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fine. I'll set it up as 48 seats with the option to add seats at the same per-seat rate through the term. The pricing sheet has standard at $68 per user per month and admin at $92, billed annually. Does that match what you were expecting?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that lines up. The annual invoice should be around $40,000, give or take taxes, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, subtotal comes to $40,128 for the 12 months. Taxes will depend on the billing address, but the billing tool will calculate that on the invoice. I have your billing address as 2140 Westlake Drive, Suite 300, Plano, Texas.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's the one. Can you make the start date August 15? Our go-live target is September 3, but IT wants two weeks for setup and SSO testing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Contract start August 15, initial term through August 14 next year. We'll include implementation support, 10 hours, no separate fee, and I'll note the September 3 go-live target for our onboarding team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. One thing on payment terms, our standard is net 45. Your draft said net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can request net 45 through deal desk. That's usually approved for annual prepay at this size. If they push back, I'll let you know today, but I don't expect an issue.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the revised order form when that's ready. If legal doesn't have any comments, I can route it for signature tomorrow.
